title: GRID Executive Summary (one page)
description: Final output of the Executive Summary DAG. Covers the 11 checklist items from the training guide plus 4 GRID additions (verdict, key figures, key risks, limitations). Must fit one A4 page: the sum of all item texts is capped by 'word_count' <= 600.

mode.description: derived = compressed from a finished Feasibility Report JSON (preferred). standalone = built from intake plus an existing Market Insight report.

source_report_id.description: Feasibility Report or Market Insight id this summary was built from.

key_figures.description: Up to 6 headline figures shown as a KPI strip at the top of the page, e.g. lot area, zonal value, asking price range, capital required, IRR, payback. Financial KPIs stay null with status 'to_be_confirmed' unless the owner supplied cost and funding inputs.

project_description.description: What the project or property is: site, size, intended use, stage.

company_developer.description: Who owns or will develop it and their track record. Owner input.

goals_objectives.description: What the owner wants to achieve, taken from the intended use chosen at intake.

location_analysis.description: Access, corridor, nearby demand anchors, infrastructure.

market_analysis.description: Demand, supply, prices (asking vs closed stated), absorption.

technical_study.description: Zoning class, permitted uses, utilities, site constraints, permits path.

socio_economic.description: Population, incomes, employment, road and government projects, political or LGU factors.

environmental.description: Flood, fault, landslide, liquefaction flags; ECC requirement.

financial_projection.description: Capital required, returns, break-even. Inputs required unless owner supplied costs and funding.

conclusion.description: The decision and what must be true for it to hold.

limitations.description: What this summary could not cover and which missing inputs caused it. Always rendered, even when empty, as a one-line 'Scope and limits' footer.

text.description: Two to four sentences. Empty string only when coverage is inputs_required or out_of_scope.

see_section.description: Feasibility Report section id to jump to, when mode is derived.
